_source: Sandbox test personas from @crscreditapi/crs-calhacks-mcp-server 1.1.2 (MIT, CRS Credit API). All data is fake. Send a body exactly as given: only an exact match gets the free canned sandbox answer.

P01.name: MARGARET OKAFOR
P01.summary: Long, clean credit history, low utilization, no public records, identity verifies cleanly.
P01.fraud_finder_expected: risk.score 11 (low). Send name, phone, email and address; ipAddress is free.
P01.identity_verification_expected: result PASS. name, SSN, DOB and address all verify

P02.name: DANIEL WHITFIELD

P12.name: VICTOR ANAND
P12.summary: Applicant supplies a name and DOB that do not belong to the SSN; bureaus return no file, TU identity fails, AtData flags it.
P12.fraud_finder_expected: risk.score 85 (high), phone owner no_match, IP > 1000 miles. Send name, phone, email and address; ipAddress is free.
P12.data_prefill_expected: one result for RAJESH MENON (a different person)
P12.identity_verification_expected: result FAIL. SSN issued to a different name; DOB mismatch; address not associated with SSN
P12.credit_report_expected: (TU / EFX / EXP): NoFileReturnedNoHit at all three bureaus

P13.name: KAYLA BRENNAN
P13.summary: Looks like a new consumer but has 9 inquiries in 60 days, an email created days ago, phone registered to someone else, IP far from the address.
P13.fraud_finder_expected: risk.score 88 (high), email 3 days old, phone owner no_match, voip prepaid. Send name, phone, email and address; ipAddress is free.
P13.identity_verification_expected: result FAIL. SSN issue date inconsistent with DOB; multiple names linked to SSN

P14.name: HAROLD PETTIGREW

P14.fraud_finder_expected: risk.score 80 (high), email invalid, phone dead. Send name, phone, email and address; ipAddress is free.
P14.identity_verification_expected: result FAIL. SSN reported as belonging to a deceased person (Death Master File)
P14.credit_report_expected: (TU / EFX / EXP): errorMessages 'deceased' at all three bureaus, no creditFiles

P16.name: SAMUEL OYELARAN

P16.identity_verification_expected: result KBA_REQUIRED. basic verification passes but fraud alert triggers step-up; KBA questions then OTP to phone on file (needs TUC3004 on the quote)
